contradictions.what: Rep says nothing could be done and it was decided before the room, yet describes fixable findings and a late analysis that landed after the test finished.
CFO approval went up two weeks before the last call, while rep says it was decided before they got in the room; timing of decision versus rep engagement is unclear.
Rep says they weren't really pitching, yet describes answering with the Authorization Boost deck and offering a roadmap session.
Rep learned of evaluation only at the renewal notice and had not met Stefan; Stefan says he heard from Stripe only when he said he was leaving.
Rep says the US stayed, and Stefan asked to split the contract, while the final statement says they went with local acquiring; only part moved, extent unspecified.
Rep calls the account healthy and not on anyone's list, yet the original buyer had left a year earlier and a new payments head was installed unnoticed.

dodges.question: When did you first feel this was lost? What happened right before?
dodges.what: Said there was no moment and it was decided before the room, then later described a late analysis, a missing named contact, and a CFO approval timeline.

dodges.question: Which markets did Stefan flag?
dodges.what: Rep did not know exactly; named only Brazil and a couple in Europe and never saw the analysis.

dodges.question: Which part of our pitch got a reaction, and which got silence?
dodges.what: Rep said it was a renewal with no real pitch, offered general product praise, and named no part that got a positive reaction.
